broll.purpose: Test pattern standing in for an aerial shot

prompt.action: a slow, steady drift across the empty studio

clips.line: A few unanswered WhatsApp enquiries don't seem like a big deal. Now multiply that across all your clinic locations.

line.say: A few unanswered WhatsApp enquiries don't seem like a big deal.
Now multiply that across all your clinic locations.

prompt.delivery: Easy and conversational, slightly wry on "don't seem like a big deal", then leaning in with weight on "multiply".
prompt.gesture: on "WhatsApp" he turns one open palm toward frame right; on "multiply" he spreads both hands apart above the table.

clips.line: One at your first clinic. Another at your second. And more across the rest of your network.

line.say: And more across the rest of your network.

prompt.delivery: Counting off, unhurried, a small beat between each clinic, building on "the rest of your network".
prompt.gesture: on "first" he places one hand on the table, on "second" a little further along it, and on "network" he sweeps that hand wide across the table.
